description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component that implements LogNode. It formats and displays log messages within a UI component, supporting chained log nodes for log processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView implementation that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface, formatting log details and supporting chaining to other LogNode objects.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data (priority, tag, message, throwable) into a string and asynchronously updates the UI to display the log message; passes the message along a chain if a next LogNode is set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log string as a new line in the TextView.
